subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

The eggs __are warm into__ a suitable temperature for the larvae to hatch from eggs.
solution:
The correct answer is -** 'are warmed to'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** Simple Present Tense**.
 
• We use is, am, are with third form of verb to make **passive voice **of a simple present tense sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct option is** (3).**

 

**The correct sentence: **The eggs ***are warmed to__*** a suitable temperature for the larvae to hatch from eggs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In the present simple, the passive is: **am / is / are + past participle** (3rd form of the verb).

 
 
• **Example- **The machines*** are made*** in China.
 
 
 
• ​Let us consider the example below--
 
 
 

 
 **Subject**
 **Verb**
 **Object**

 The Teacher
 helps
 the new students.
 
 

 **Passive**
 The new students
